a: Scopes limit what an access token is allowed to do.
PKCE protects public OAuth clients from code interception.
Short-lived access tokens reduce damage if stolen.
Refresh tokens obtain new access tokens; store them carefully.
Rotate API keys and revoke old ones after leaks.
Credentialed CORS requires specific origins, not *.
Use frame-ancestors in CSP or X-Frame-Options.
Useful headers include CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options.
Dependabot-style tools open PRs for vulnerable packages.
Cloud roles should grant minimal actions on minimal resources.
